title: Test: evaluateTiming rounds a partial-minute remainder up
description: 30 seconds remaining should display as 1 minute remaining, not 0 -- rounding down would tell the user they're already eligible when they're not.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun evaluateTiming_tooSoon_roundsUpPartialMinute() constructs a DoseLog given at 0L with a 60-minute interval, evaluates a candidate 30 seconds before the 60-minute boundary (60 * 60_000L - 30_000L), asserts the result is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon, and asserts its minutesRemaining equals 1L
